versions.changelog:
netdisk-search v1.0.1

- Improved scripts/search.py to fix CLI encoding issues and support Windows console output.
- No user-facing changes to the SKILL.md contents. All usage and documentation remain the same.
- Internal improvements for stability when running search.py in diverse environments.

- Initial release of netdisk-search skill.
- Enables high-performance search across 14 major Chinese netdisk types (Baidu, Quark, Aliyun, 115, etc).
- Supports multi-keyword queries, filtering, smart sorting, and link validity checking.
- Easy one-click Docker deployment; API and command line available.
- Provides search, resource verification, and deployment triggers for integration with Hermes Agent and OpenClaw.
- Includes detailed documentation, configuration options, and best practices.
